title: Explainer authoring redesign recap

claims.text: The project replaced fixed authoring slots with narrative and artistic paths selected by recipe policy.
Author identity and method are caller-owned while the core validates provenance and hash-pinned shells.
Rendered-browser review found styling defects that structural tests and release validation did not detect.
The merged foundation closed with 231 core tests, 59 adapter tests, and release validation passing.

readerQuestions: What changed in the shipped architecture?
Which evidence proves the redesign and its remaining gap?
